text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. newspaper, Wall Street Journal, hails Morocco's privatisation programme as successful.
- Marrakesh to host fourth annual meeting on surgery within Maghreb Arab countries on Nov 7.
- Extension of resting period to four months would benefit fish stocks but be detrimental to fishermen who would get no compensation.
- State-owned Royal Air Maroc to add two Boeing 737-800s to its fleet.
- Controversy over restructuring loss-making state-owned mining company Bureau de Recherches et de Participation Minieres which would entail staff reduction.
